2602001.name: An Idyllic Trip
2602001.desc:
I’ve joined the expedition team as a special observer!
Beautiful and wondrous Idyll, here I come!
Aniimo—here I come!

2602112.name: Aniimo Catching Journey
2602112.desc:
Starfall Valley—the starting zone selected by the Polaris Institute.
This land is rich with life, home to all kinds of Aniimo.
Catch a few and record them in your Aniilog.

2602114.name: The Mysterious Cavern
2602114.desc:
While chasing BINI #9, I stumble into a mysterious cavern!
Where am I? It feels like some kind of ancient ruins...
Whatever this place is, I should leave as soon as I can.

3707004.name: Institute Initiation
3707004.desc:
After quite the adventure, I made my way back to Astra...
And became a new student at the Polaris Institute!

3502001.name: Setting Out Again
3502001.desc:
Dr. Lewis has given me my first task.
I’m to travel to the beautiful Branch and earn its recognition...
And collect some Lumin Amber along the way!

3502110.name: Chasing the Clouds
3502110.desc:
Next stop: Nimbus Fields.
I need to find Lana and finish my freshman guidance lesson!

5701082.name: Go to Bloomville
5701082.desc:
I met up with Nicole again, and we set out for Bloomville...
But along the way, all the Aniimo we saw were fast asleep by the side of the road!
What could have happened here?

5701140.name: Ceremony Preparations
5701140.desc:
We finally made it to Bloomville!
They say the Bloom Festival can make wishes come true...
First things first—let’s prepare the perfume for the ceremony!

5701132.name: The Unbegun Ceremony
5701132.desc:
On the day of the Bloom Festival, Irelia never showed up...
Instead, a Somniwing named Velouria appeared.
What’s going on...?

3701030.name: Binding Oath
3701030.chapter: The Legend of Mist and Light
3701030.desc:
After being defeated by you, the Tucking fled in a hurry.
There’s a new hole in the ground of the Mistwoods, and...
a <u icon="Symbol2">strange Hummin</u> who speaks human language?

3901016.name: A Fragrant Journey: Echoback Landing
3901016.desc:
<u icon="Symbol2">Perfumer Elvira</u> always sits at Bloomville’s entrance.
Word is she’s searching for the treasure of Echoback Landing, the Whalesong Blossom.
They say that this flower only blooms once it senses longing...

3901001.name: Everlasting Echoback Song
3901001.desc:
A massive skeleton, a mysterious painter, and the sound of an Echoback song...
What stories do the shores of Echoback Landing hold?

3705001.name: Stars and the Knight
3705001.desc:
A few curious Susutas have appeared at Echoback Landing.
It’s said they’re looking for <u icon="Symbol1">shells taken from them by Sherros</u>...
Strange, why would Sherros take their shells?

4706010.name: Is That a... Lighthouse?
4706010.desc:
On the Tideblossom Coast at night, beneath the Golden Shooting Star,
a <u icon="Symbol2">Bulbly</u> always sits at the cliff’s edge, gazing out to sea.
Who knows what unspoken thoughts it carries.

5101004.name: Mysterious Presence
5101004.desc:
Holographic devices in Astra have been malfunctioning a lot lately.
 Some people even claim they’ve seen something... strange. What’s going on?

5103001.name: Mysterious Presence - Super Claw Malfunction
5103001.desc:
Holographic devices in Astra have been malfunctioning a lot lately.
 Some people even claim they’ve seen something... strange. What’s going on?

4710001.name: Sink into the Colorless Dream
4710001.desc: The seedling at the center of Amethyst Tree seems to have changed. She sleeps—no one knows when she will wake, but... she still seems to sense the world.

4707020.name: Come Out, Floret
4707020.desc:
During the day, in front of a certain house in Bloomville,
flower farmer boy Clovis crouches on an empty patch of ground,
seemingly talking to a little flower?

1908007.name: Family Reunion
1908007.desc:
The strange Hexxin wants you to find her 7 children.
Just where in the forest are these children?

4709001.name: Flowers and Thorns - Sea of Flowers
4709001.chapter: The Legend of Flowers and Thorns
4709001.desc:
In an abandoned house within the Sea of Flowers,
the Budsquires seem to be holding a tea party.
Wonder what kind of story will they tell?

4709017.name: Flowers and Thorns - Rosetower Wood
4709017.chapter: The Legend of Flowers and Thorns
4709017.desc:
A maze of thorns lies in the eastern part of Rosetower Woods,
and somewhere inside lies a secret of the Budsquire family.

4709032.name: A Fragrant Journey: Rosetower Woods
4709032.chapter: The Legend of Flowers and Thorns
4709032.desc:
To the people of Bloomville,
Rosetower Woods is considered dangerous territory.
So why would perfumer Awen find herself there?

4709079.name: Flowers and Thorns: Rosetower Wood - Sightseeing
4709079.chapter: The Legend of Flowers and Thorns
4709079.desc: What changes did the Melloblum’s Dance of Blissful Bloom bring to Rosetower Woods?

3002030.name: A Fragrant Journey: Forest of Falling Stars
3002030.chapter: The Legend of the Land of Falling Stars
3002030.desc:
Outside the empty Nest of Stars in the Forest of Falling Stars,
perfumer Dael looks worried.
Perhaps he’s run into some kind of trouble?

3708001.name: Warrior
3708001.desc:
In the Dead Forest of Beast Fang Ridge,
there’s a legend about "a wolf’s head taking flight" in the night.

3708017.name: Fists I
3708017.desc:
Icho, the Scorchhowl who stands beside Dr. Lewis,
has opened a course on the meaning of combat.
And the answer seems to lie somewhere within Thousand-Fang Ridge.

3708068.name: Fists II
3708068.desc:
What kind of past does Icho actually have?
Perhaps some of the locals in Beast Fang Ridge know a thing or two.

3708035.name: A Fragrant Journey: Beast Fang Ridge
3708035.desc:
Bloomville’s perfumers are always busy with something.
Perfumer Ranka, though, is lying by the lake, perfectly at ease.

3709001.name: An Answer from the Heavens
3709001.desc:
During the day, the Bolty always gather beneath the Blitz Tree.
It looks like they’re... making phone calls?

3709031.name: A Fragrant Journey: Blitzwood
3709031.desc:
Bloomville perfumer Avetine is about to set off on a long journey.
Right now, she’s offering a hefty reward on behalf of her apprentice Baboni for:
the treasure of Blitzwood, <u icon="Symbol4">"the Golden Answer."</u>

4702003.name: Warrior
4702003.chapter: The Legend of Helmuts and Helgons
4702003.desc:
The painter Sorora stands looking at a painting in Russet Highlands,
muttering the strange phrase "a ghost swings its sword at the dragon."
It seems to be connected to a memory he’s lost.

3712001.name: Helmut’s Island Adventure
3712001.chapter: The Legend of Helmuts and Helgons
3712001.desc:
On the island, Scar-faced Helgon has been capturing Helmut left and right, seemingly because his son wants <u icon="Symbol1">a Helmut friend</u> of his own?
Maybe only by twining into Helmut can you move freely around the island.

3712002.name: Island Adventure: Nightfall Tales
3712002.chapter: The Legend of Helmuts and Helgons
3712002.desc:
A bonfire. A ring of stone seats... 
Outside the Russet Highlands, 
perhaps someone will speak of ancient, forgotten tales beneath the quiet night sky.

3712003.name: A Fragrant Journey: Russet Highlands
3712003.chapter: The Legend of Helmuts and Helgons
3712003.desc:
During the day, near Bloomville’s perfume workshop,
there are two perfumers who look nearly identical but couldn’t be more different.
What’s the story between sisters Grace and Cress?

3710001.name: Fly Free!
3710001.chapter: The Legend of the Bell of Freedom
3710001.desc:
After the Legendary Windgliders left Argent Strait, the Bell of Freedom by Crescendo Cliff fell silent. 
O wind that crosses the seas, when will you return?

3711001.name: The Perfect Path
3711001.chapter: The Legend of the Berylline Vale
3711001.desc:
Baleetle Jenny stands in the middle of the road in Berylline Vale, 
seemingly searching for the owner of a lost stone ball.

3711003.name: A Fragrant Journey: Berylline Vale
3711003.chapter: The Legend of the Berylline Vale
3711003.desc:
Not far from the elder’s house in Bloomville,
perfumer Marlowe is enthusiastically promoting his new product.
So why is there nobody around him?

3713001.name: Fentufts and the Nimbi
3713001.desc:
I’ve arrived at Driftwise Meadow, blanketed in melancholic mist.
Is that... Fentuft picking on a Nimbi?

3713003.name: A Fragrant Journey: Driftwise Meadow
3713003.desc:
Perfumer Fantine stands by the river in Driftwise Meadow,
looking a little melancholy.
She’s caught up in wondering whether she even deserves to be happy.

4710018.name: Land Color: Crescendo
4710018.desc:
The Crescendo Cliff at Argent Strait holds a Bell of Freedom,
crystallizing the green of the Breezy Plains.
A perfumer used it to blend Freedom’s Breeze.

4710021.name: Land Color: Blitz
4710021.desc:
Blitzwood has a thunder-crackling Blitz Tree,
crystallizing the yellow of the Breezy Plains.
A perfumer used it to blend Golden Wish.

4710025.name: Land Color: Thousand Ridges
4710025.desc:
The most flourishing Ridgeback Tree in Beast Fang Ridge
crystallizes the orange of the Breezy Plains.
A perfumer used it to blend Heartfire Orange.

4710029.name: Land Color: Echoback
4710029.desc:
Echoback Landing holds a crystal-clear Whalesong Blossom,
crystallizing the pink of the Breezy Plains.
A perfumer used it to blend Whisper of Longing.

4710033.name: Land Color: Twister
4710033.desc:
The Twister Peaks of the Russet Highlands has a Flame Flower,
crystallizing the red of the Breezy Plains.
A perfumer used it to blend Eternal Red.

4710037.name: Land Color: Driftwise
4710037.desc:
Driftwise Meadow holds a vibrant Bittersweet Bloom,
crystallizing the blue of the Breezy Plains.
A perfumer used it to blend Heart’s Resonance.

4710041.name: Land Color: Glimmer
4710041.desc:
Glimmer Fruit lies within the shadows of the Mistwoods,
crystallizing the black of the Breezy Plains.
A perfumer used it to blend Binding Oath.

4710045.name: Land Color: Berylline
4710045.desc:
Berylline Vale holds a twin-stemmed Stoneflower,
crystallizing the cyan of the Breezy Plains.
A perfumer used it to blend Perfect Mistake.

4710049.name: Land Color: Rosetower
4710049.desc:
The top of Rosetower holds a Whitesnow Rose,
crystallizing the white of the Breezy Plains.
A perfumer used it to blend Home.

4710052.name: Land Color: Falling Stars
4710052.desc:
The Forest of Falling Stars has a giant Starine Tree,
crystallizing the purple of the Breezy Plains.
A perfumer used it to blend Peace of Mind.

6505002.name: Prologue: The Wondrous RV
6505002.desc:
A strange vehicle sits parked in Nimbus Fields.
Huh, why would there be a car on Idyll?

6510009.name: Act 1: Together with Aniimo
6510009.desc:
The Aniimo have entered my Home space.
Their activities really produce resources?
What a clever idea.

6511019.name: Act Two: A Richer Harvest
6511019.desc:
New orders have come in from Astra’s merchants.
Time to try out more production formulas!

6512002.name: Act Four: Go Out and Explore (Part 1)
6512002.desc:
Stumbled upon a lost Legendary Nimbi by accident!
Looks like it even brought back a few gifts...?

6512011.name: Act Four: Go Out and Explore (Part 2)
6512011.desc:
Fannie installed a signal transmitter in the Homeland.
Time to send the Aniimo out to explore!
No more worrying about them getting lost!

6513001.name: Act 8: Facilities, Orders, and Life: Part 1
6513001.desc:
More and more facilities are filling the Homeland...
Aniimo are starting to feel worn out.
Fannie is working hard to find a solution...

6513038.name: Act 8: Facilities, Orders, and Life: Part 2
6513038.desc:
Fannie has introduced a power system to the Home!
Now Aniimo have a much easier time.

6514001.name: Act Five: Climate Control System (Part 1)
6514001.desc:
GoGoHomes received an order for flowers.
That means some new modifications are in order...

6514021.name: Act Five: Climate Control System (Part 2)
6514021.desc:
The Home now has a climate control system installed.
Outdoor air conditioning, right in the middle of nowhere?

6515001.name: Act 10: Starry Sky and Flowers
6515001.desc:
The annual Astra new technology showcase is being held once again.
Fannie has brought GoGoHomes’ latest developments.
What kind of results will it bring this time?

6520001.name: Act Three: A Whole New Formula
6520001.desc:
Fannie gave me a call.
They’ve developed a whole batch of new Formulas...

6521001.name: Act Six: The Dream House (Part 1)
6521001.desc:
Fannie called to check in on how things were going.
Still wishing I had somewhere to sleep and rest...

6521002.name: Act Six: The Dream House (Part 2)
6521002.desc:
A new plot has been connected to the Home space!
Time to build my very own dream house here!

6522001.name: Act Seven: Astra’s Festival Season
6522001.desc:
Astra is about to welcome a new holiday.
Wonder if there’ll be a proper celebration.

6523001.name: Act 9: Lucky Gift
6523001.desc:
Fannie has brought me a thank-you gift.
It’s a... gachapon?

5613001.desc: Another assessment is coming up! This time, my target is Lainey at the Boomblast Arena!

7701001.desc: Where could the Pranky from five years ago be now?

7702002.name: Power of Homesickness
7702002.desc:
Why is the Cozite in the Institute’s hall so sad?
